Consider the picture above. Which of the following is a unit vector that is parallel to $a+b?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we have to find $a+b.$ According to the triangle law of addition, the resultant $a+b$ goes from the tail of $a$ to the head of $b:$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14253719/assets/f95b72a0b508e0cdacef7de386888f3b473aeba01574ce5fb345b9fec74bb900.png)

In $△AHB$, we have $∠AHB={90}^{∘}$, $AH=2$ and $BH=2.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}|a+b| & =AB \\  & =\sqrt{A{H}^{2}+B{H}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{2}^{2}} \\  & =2\sqrt{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, the magnitude of $a+b$ is $2\sqrt{2}.$ Consequently, the unit vector is

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =\frac{1}{|a+b|}\cdot (a+b) \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}(a+b).\end{aligned}
$$
